name: Progression 3: the rested bank's quantum capped at zero (56-review-progression.md section 2.5; 44 P-X26, roadmap R5)
why: Every XP grant passes a rested quantum of 0, so the bank fills and pays nothing. Capping the quantum at zero is what removing the mechanism does to the numbers. An identity patch: no number in any cell and no band may move. If one does, something reads the bank and the removal is not free.
